title: Does Adding Benign Finetuning Data After Misalignment Training Reverse the Effect?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Directly quantifies the 'undo cost' for misalignment, which is critical for model providers. If cheap reversal works, the practical threat is manageable. If not, it motivates stronger prevention. Clear actionable outcome.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Uses existing misaligned model + standard SFT datasets (publicly available). Sequential finetuning on varying data amounts is straightforward. Activation analysis adds optional complexity but the core experiment is accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Single variable (amount of benign data), single metric (misalignment rate). Multiple data sizes but each is a continuation of the same finetuning run. Clear dose-response deliverable. Fits within 30 hours.
